description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the UserDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various user-related database operations such as saving users, checking existence, retrieving user details, and managing user roles.

classes.name: UserDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the UserDao data access object, specifically the user management functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the UserDao instance and sets up test fixture data before each test.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a UserRole entity by ID.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve an Employee entity by employee number.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUser
methods.description: Tests the saving of a system user and verifies persistence.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForNonExistingUser
methods.description: Checks for a non-existing user to ensure it returns null.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForExistingUser
methods.description: Checks for an existing user to ensure it returns a User instance.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForDeletedUser
methods.description: Verifies that a deleted user is not recognized as existing.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForEmptyPasswordUser
methods.description: Verifies behavior for users with empty passwords.

methods.name: testGetSystemUser
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a system user by ID.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserForNonExistingId
methods.description: Ensures null is returned when retrieving a non-existent user by ID.

methods.name: testGetAssignableUserRoles
methods.description: Checks retrieval of roles assignable to users.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserIdList
methods.description: Verifies the list of system user IDs.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserIdListForOneActiveUser
methods.description: Tests filtering of active users, verifying the list adjusts after marking some users as deleted.

methods.name: testGetEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employees by user role, with filters for terminated employees.

methods.name: testUserStatusByUserName
methods.description: Checks whether a username exists in the system.
